_meta.source_tool: IBM DOORS Next Generation v7.0 — Requirements Export
_meta.description: Regulatory requirements extracted from SOLAS Chapter II-1 Reg.35, MARPOL 73/78 Annex I Reg.22, and IEC 60945:2002 §4.3 for use by RequirementMapper.

requirements.name: WaterLevelRequirement
requirements.text: The bilge water level shall not exceed 300 mm (0.3 m) above the bilge floor during normal automated operation.
requirements.subject: BilgePumpSystem
requirements.rationale: Prevents engine room flooding that compromises watertight integrity per IMO MARPOL 73/78 Annex I Regulation 22

requirements.name: PumpRedundancyRequirement
requirements.text: The bilge pump system shall include a designated redundant pump (Pump B) with an independent power feed, capable of maintaining full discharge capacity in the event of Pump A failure.
requirements.subject: BilgePumpSystem
requirements.rationale: DNV Rules for Ships Pt.4 Ch.6 §3 and SOLAS II-1 Reg.35 require independent redundant pump with separate power feed
requirements.regulatory_source: DNV Rules Pt.4 Ch.6; SOLAS II-1

requirements.name: AlarmResponseRequirement
requirements.text: The alarm system shall activate audible and visual annunciation within 2.0 seconds of the controller issuing an alarm trigger, in compliance with IEC 60945 Section 4.3.
requirements.subject: BilgePumpSystem
requirements.rationale: IEC 60945:2002 §4.3 — all Class A alarms on commercial vessels must activate within 2.0 s

requirements.name: DischargeCapacityRequirement
requirements.text: The combined discharge capacity of the bilge pumping system shall exceed the maximum design inflow rate from the worst-case damage stability scenario.
requirements.subject: BilgePumpSystem
requirements.rationale: SOLAS Chapter II-1 Regulation 35 — pump capacity must exceed worst-case flooding inflow to maintain freeboard
